covers: The actual UI/behavior of the hidden admin surfaces (/xloginy purchase dashboard, /xerrors error inbox, /xpricing package pricing, /xversion min-app-version + usage report, /xnotificationy broadcast + individual notifications, /xactivityy, /xpartnersy, /xsupport) — routing.json only documents that they exist and are unlisted; this covers what they render and how they authenticate.

shared_shell.component: AdminNav.tsx and AdminLoginCard.tsx provide the shared admin shell; the rail mark is public/logo-icon.png linked to '/'. See f051/f099.
shared_shell.layouts: src/app/xloginy/layout.tsx, src/app/xerrors/layout.tsx, and src/app/xpricing/layout.tsx all set indexable:false via createMetadata — belt-and-suspenders with the privateRoutePrefixes robots/sitemap exclusion in routing.json

auth_pattern.storage: All three pages store the admin dashboard token in sessionStorage under the SAME key, ADMIN_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY = 'velocity-admin-dashboard-token' — logging in on one page also authenticates the others on the next load.
auth_pattern.risk: sessionStorage is JS-readable (unlike the httpOnly esim_at/esim_rt user-session cookies in topics/auth.json) — an XSS on any admin page would be able to read the admin dashboard token directly, a materially different trust model from the regular user session (f044).
auth_pattern.duplication: RESOLVED (f052): all three pages now use the shared src/app/useAdminSession.ts hook + AdminLoginCard.tsx — xloginy and xerrors were retrofitted onto it during the 2026-08-23 premium redesign, closing out what f045 originally flagged.
auth_pattern.backend_note: the token itself and its issuance are backend concepts (see E-SIM backend feedAI's admin.json topic) — this file only covers how the Next.js pages consume it.

xloginy_purchase_dashboard.data_source: GET /bff/admin/dashboard (Bearer token) -> {summary:{purchaseCount,userCount,revenueByCurrency,latestPurchaseAt}, chart:[{date,purchases,revenueCents}], purchases:Purchase[], users:DashboardUser[], recentOtpRequests:OtpRequestEvent[]}
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.renders: 4 summary stat cards (total purchases/revenue/latest purchase/total users), a hand-rolled inline SVG bar chart component (PurchasesChart, no charting library) for purchases-over-time, and 3 tables: Purchases (email/package/price/status/date), Users (email/created/updated/otpRequestCount/lastOtpRequestedAt), Recent OTP requests (email/status/timestamp/error).
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.pagination: f088 (2026-09-02): each of the 3 tables got its own page/pageSize selector + prev/next controls, matching the backend's now-paginated GET /api/admin/dashboard (E-SIM backend f118). bff/admin/dashboard/route.ts forwards the pagination query params through unchanged; summary stats still reflect ALL rows, not just the current page.
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.formatting: formatMoney uses Intl.NumberFormat with the purchase's own currency (paymentCurrency), amountCents/100; formatDate uses Intl.DateTimeFormat medium/short.

xerrors_error_inbox.data_source: GET /bff/admin/errors (filterable by email/requestId/area/severity/unresolvedOnly) -> ErrorEvent[]; PATCH /bff/admin/errors/:id to set resolved/adminNotes; POST /bff/admin/errors/:id/repair to run the backend's repairAction
xerrors_error_inbox.layout: master-detail: a filterable table on the left (time/severity/area/email/method+path/status/message/state), clicking a row selects it and shows full detail in a right-hand aside (request id, user, API path, provider info, related payment/package/ICCID, repair action, safe request body/query as pretty-printed JSON).
xerrors_error_inbox.safe_curl_reconstruction: buildSafeCurl() client-side rebuilds a copy-pasteable curl command from the error's method/path/safeRequestBody for reproducing the failing request — uses a hardcoded base URL 'https://esim.uplisoft.com' (f046), so this reconstructed curl always points at production regardless of which backend the admin actually meant to test against.
xerrors_error_inbox.actions: Copy request id, Copy safe cURL (clipboard), Save admin notes, Mark resolved, and (only when the error has a repairAction) Run repair — a one-click trigger of the backend's idempotent provisioning retry (see E-SIM backend feedAI's admin.json 'repair_actions').

xpricing_price_management.data_source: GET /bff/admin/packages/pricing -> {packages:[{packageId,title,country,countryCode,flagUrl,type,network,dataLabel,durationDays,originalPrice,retailPrice,discountEnabled,discountType,discountValue,discountDirection,finalPrice}]} (countryCode/flagUrl/network/dataLabel/durationDays added 2026-08-24, f055; discountDirection added 2026-08-24, f061); PUT /bff/admin/packages/pricing/:packageId to save one row; POST /bff/admin/packages/pricing/bulk-discount ({packageIds:'all'|string[], discountEnabled, discountType, discountValue, discountDirection}) to apply an adjustment to many rows at once without touching retailPrice/sell price.
xpricing_price_management.renders: 3 summary stat cards (total packages/with discount/selected), a bulk-discount panel (enable toggle, direction decrease|increase (f061), percentage|flat, value, 'Apply to selected (N)' / 'Apply to ALL packages'), a 'Reset to default' panel (added 2026-08-24, f059: 'Reset selected (N)' / 'Reset ALL to default' buttons, POST /bff/admin/packages/pricing/reset {packageIds:'all'|string[]}), and a searchable, checkbox-selectable table: Coverage (flag+country), Type (icon), Network, Package (dataLabel), Validity (durationDays), Buy price (read-only originalPrice, re-added 2026-08-24 per f061 after being dropped by f055), Sell price (editable retailPrice, relabeled from 'Retail price' by f061) and Adjustment (discount/markup fields with a decrease/increase direction selector), a client-computed finalPrice preview under the 'Price' header (previewFinalPrice(), mirrors the backend's computeFinalPrice formula so the row updates live before Save), and a per-row action cell with Save plus a Reset button (calls the same reset endpoint scoped to just that packageId).
xpricing_price_management.reset_to_default: resetPricing(packageIds) takes an explicit id array/'all' so per-row Reset avoids stale selection state. Reset deletes the backend PackagePricing override, restoring the live default for display and checkout.
xpricing_price_management.auth: uses src/app/useAdminSession.ts (see auth_pattern.duplication) rather than its own copy of the login logic.

xversion_app_version.note: min-version setter + usage report never got a feedAI entry when built (earlier 2026-08-24 commits) — backfilled here alongside the report addition (f060).
xversion_app_version.min_version_setter: GET/PUT /bff/admin/app-version -> {version, updatedAt}, proxying backend GET/PUT /admin/app-version. Text input + Save, same load/error/notice pattern as the other x* pages.
xversion_app_version.usage_report: added 2026-08-24 (f060). Second section on the same page: GET /bff/admin/app-version/report -> {report:[{platform,version,deviceCount}]}, proxying backend GET /admin/app-version/report. Rendered as two grouped lists (Android, iOS), version -> device count, newest version first (pre-sorted server-side). Own Refresh button; loaded in the same useEffect as the version setter.

xnotificationy_broadcast_notifications.note: f087 (2026-09-02): built in an earlier, undocumented pass (commits a9e7bc5, 750a2f2) — backfilled here. Standard AdminNav/AdminLoginCard/useAdminSession shell, same pattern as the other 4 admin pages.
xnotificationy_broadcast_notifications.data_source: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /bff/admin/notifications (NotificationMessage CRUD) and POST /bff/admin/notifications/:id/send, proxying E-SIM backend's f117 endpoints.
xnotificationy_broadcast_notifications.renders: a create form (title/body, at least one required) and a list of saved NotificationMessage drafts, each with Edit/Delete/Send actions. Send calls the backend's batched Firebase broadcast and surfaces {sentCount, failureCount} in a notice.

xnotificationy_individual_notifications.note: f122 (2026-09-10): Broadcast/Individual tab switcher on the same page. Individual is compose-and-fire-once (not editable drafts). Backend log is UserNotification (E-SIM backend f150). f124: Force-logout unlinked stamps User.sessionInvalidBefore on accounts with no related DeviceToken (backend f152).
xnotificationy_individual_notifications.renders: debounced email search (min 2 chars), compose title/body (at least one required), Force-logout unlinked (confirm, then POST), history list with sentCount/failureCount including zero-device sends.

xactivityy_activity_tracking.note: f091: inactivity-interval settings (GET/PATCH /bff/admin/activity/settings), read-only activity list (GET /bff/admin/activity), one global 'Send now' (POST /bff/admin/activity/notify-now) — no per-row notify, backend only supports a global broadcast. Standard AdminNav/useAdminSession shell. Widened backendFetch's method union (src/lib/backend.ts) to include PATCH.

xpartnersy_partner_admin.note: f092: affiliate/partner program admin surface. Full detail in topics/partners.json (kept out of this file to stay under budget) — also covers the larger customer-facing partner pages.

xsupport_support_inbox.note: f109: live traveler support inbox. Standard AdminNav/AdminLoginCard/useAdminSession shell, indexable:false layout.
xsupport_support_inbox.data_source: GET /bff/admin/support/threads?status=unread|read|solved; GET /bff/admin/support/threads/:id; POST messages/attachments/read/solved; GET /bff/admin/support/attachments/:id (binary). Socket.IO to Express origin (f110) for live list/message updates. Live payloads match payload.threadId or message.threadId (f120) so the open chat and list preview get the text, not only the unread badge.
xsupport_support_inbox.renders: Unread/Open/Solved tabs with unread badge, email search, master-detail chat, photo bubbles, Mark as solved. Opening an unread thread POSTs /read. Solved threads move to the archive tab.
xsupport_support_inbox.shared_helpers: Support response types live in src/app/xsupport/support-types.ts; admin BFF request helpers live in src/lib/admin-bff.ts (f116).
